issue.title: Can't use `-` as option value
issue.body:
For example we have a subcommand/command flag:

```go
&cli.StringFlag{
          Name:     "output",
          Usage:    "output file name",
          Aliases:  []string{"o"},
          Required: false,
          Value:    "",
},
```

and then in command handler we have the following code:

```go
outFile := cCtx.String("output")

if outFile == "-" {     // traditional UNIX convention
    outFile = "/dev/stdout"
}

// code that writes output

```

In UNIX I can do:

```
$ foo bar -o file.txt
$ foo bar -o /dev/stdout
$ foo bar -o -                         # the same
$ foo bar -o-                          # works in UNIX, doesn't in THE CLI
```

`-o-` works under `getopt` , works under `argparse`, but doesn't under the cli.

the cli prints error:

```
Incorrect Usage: flag provided but not defined: -o-
```
